title: Destroy and remove a stack
summary: Use destroy --preview-only for a read-only resource deletion preview without --yes or --confirm-destroy. The same guard protects destroy, its preview and stack rm: a committed consumer blocks when its origin_ip is empty; a set origin_ip makes the VPS name only a live selector, which stays in use. origin_ip is read under the namespace declared by infra/Pulumi.yaml, and other keys in the consumer file are ignored; a missing or non-string origin_ip refuses with repair instructions. The guard reads only committed config: outside a git checkout with a commit, or while infra/Pulumi.yaml or a consumer stack file has uncommitted changes (untracked included), it refuses with pulumi_stack_consumer_uncommitted; commit or revert the named file, then retry. Mutating destroy and stack rm still require exact stack confirmation.
